errors.evidence: The figure contains two charts for comparison, titled 'AttentionInfluence' and 'FineWeb-Edu Classifier'. The description exclusively discusses the 'FineWeb-Edu Classifier' chart, completely omitting the 'AttentionInfluence' chart and the comparative purpose of the figure.
The figure displays two distinct nested pie charts, not a single one.

The 'FineWeb-Edu Classifier' chart consists of 16 distinct data slices. The description's count of 21 is incorrect, as it seems to mistakenly include aggregate labels and categories from the other chart.
The label 'Education 38' represents the total value for an entire group of slices (the green-colored group), not a distinct slice itself. The description misinterprets the chart's nested structure.
This category does not exist in either chart. The left chart has 'Fin & Law 3' and 'Tech & Engineer 12'.
The category 'Policy' only appears in the 'AttentionInfluence' chart, not in the 'FineWeb-Edu Classifier' chart that the description is attempting to detail.
The 'Education' group of slices is colored green/teal in the chart, not yellow.
The 'Science & technology education' slice is colored green/teal, not cyan.
The 'Health & Medicine' group of slices is colored light blue, not pink. Additionally, its value in this chart is 19, not 22 (which is from the other chart).
The 'Diseases' slice is colored light blue, not red.
The 'Nutrition' slice is colored light blue, not purple.
The 'Emerging tech' slice is colored brown, not light blue.
The value for 'Society & culture' in the 'FineWeb-Edu Classifier' chart is 5. The description incorrectly uses the value 10 from the 'AttentionInfluence' chart.

errors.text_span: Percentage values are included directly within several of the slices.
errors.evidence: Numerical values are provided for all 16 slices and all aggregate groups, not just 'several' of them.
